gap: No result ChatGPT got states that K&F Concept's own pages for its ND2-32 True Color variable ND filters (67 mm KF01.2079 and 77 mm KF01.2081) say the filter is 'not suitable for lens hoods' because its front is one size larger and has a push rod, so it needs a 72 mm or 82 mm lens cap. None of those results maps the filter sizes to real lenses either: the SIRUI 50mm 1.33x (67 mm thread) takes the 67 mm filter directly, the Meike 85mm F1.8 SE Mark II (62 mm thread) needs a 62–67 mm step-up ring, and the OM System TG-7 has no filter thread until you add the CLA-T01 adapter (40.5 mm).
standout_why: ChatGPT ran an empty search and got no ranked or cited results, so there is no rival page to compare against. Its answer only explains fixed ND vs variable ND and asks for the shopper's camera and lens. It gives no filter-thread matching, no lens-hood or lens-cap limits, and no adapter needs for a compact camera.
decides: The finding changes the pick from 'any variable ND' to the size that matches the lens. Buy the 67 mm K&F for 67 mm lenses such as the SIRUI 50mm F1.8 1.33x anamorphic, or the 67 mm plus a 62–67 mm step-up ring for the Meike 85mm F1.8 SE Mark II. Buy the 77 mm for 77 mm lenses. Either way, the shopper gives up the lens hood and needs a cap one size larger (72 mm or 82 mm). TG-7 owners need OM System's CLA-T01 before any screw-in filter will fit.
